stem: Sunita has a six-sided die with faces marked 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. The probability that the die shows a six on any throw is $p$. Sunita throws the die 500 times and finds that it shows a six 70 times.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Calculate an approximate 99% confidence interval for $p$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Sunita believes that the die is fair. Use your answer to part **(a)** to comment on her belief.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Sunita uses the result of her 500 throws to calculate an $\alpha$% confidence interval for $p$. This interval has width 0.04.

Find the value of $\alpha$.
